data.name: Skippie
data.long_meaning: Derived from the old English word 'Skip,' meaning to hop or move nimbly, and 'pie' meaning little, this name was originally used as a nickname for a lively and spirited child. The name Skippie brings to mind images of a carefree and joyful personality, someone who is always up for an adventure and is known for their boundless energy.
